title: Rebel TMC MPs merge with Nationalist Citizens Party, to ‘collaborate with NDA’: Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar
description: Rebel TMC MP Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar claimed to have the support of 20 Lok Sabha MPs. The TMC has 28 members in the Lok Sabha. The rebels need two-thirds of the bloc of 19 MPs to avoid disqualification under the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution.
